meta.title: Contract Expiry Notification: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify whether Contract Expiry Notification is refused or absent.
Repeat the Contract Expiry Notification test as a Category Manager and verify that it is available.
Verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and that both role comparisons use the same tenant.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Category Manager role and verify whether Contract Expiry Notification is refused or absent.; Repeat the Contract Expiry Notification test as a Category Manager and verify that it is available.; Verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan and that both role comparisons use the same tenant.

args.need: sign in as the non-Category Manager user and the Category Manager on the same Enterprise tenant, then verify whether Contract Expiry Notification is refused or absent for the former and available for the latter

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to role-specific users or operate the Contract Expiry Notification workflow.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or raw invalid values after the tester's comparison.
